agencyName: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
authorityRationale: TDLR's own primary reciprocity page — the direct, official listing of reciprocal states by license tier. Confirmed in Phase 2F.1 to be accurate but not yet updated for 3 agreements announced via separate press releases (Iowa-Master, Alabama, Ohio).
reliabilityRationale: Official primary source, but Phase 2F.1 confirmed it lags behind more recent official press releases for specific new agreements — still authoritative for the states it does list.
